understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to win each KA59 level by placing every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with '+', with the requirement that if there are multiple goal tiles they must all be occupied by selectable pieces at the same time for the engine to report WIN, and to do so within the finite step budget per level to ultimately complete the whole run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn consisted of a CLICK action on a target grid coordinate. Clicking either selected a piece or attempted to move the currently selected piece toward the clicked square (typically along a straight line), and the move would only occur if the path/landing was legal. If the destination was blocked by walls/obstacles or an invalid movement rule applied, the piece would not change position and the step was still consumed (as seen by repeated clicks at [36,18] producing no movement). Pieces could be repositioned by clicking other reachable squares (e.g., moving between [12,21] and [18,21]). Winning required ending with pieces sitting on all '+' goal tiles simultaneously.
